_comment: C0-13 microsoft-designer bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（microsoft-copilot/adobe-firefly），related 写 2 条。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: Models are routed by Microsoft; the official FAQ describes the product as generative-AI image creation and editing without publishing model-by-model versions, and users choose features rather than raw models. Designer shares ecosystem and quota conventions with the Copilot/Bing image line (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web (designer.microsoft.com) plus image capabilities embedded in Bing, Copilot and Office apps; generation runs in Microsoft’s cloud and no model runs locally. The official FAQ says Designer is integrated across the web and Microsoft apps and tools (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: Designs save automatically to Microsoft’s cloud and return through My projects, counting against the universal Microsoft storage quota; uploaded personal images go to OneDrive and must be deleted there. No model runs locally, and exported downloads belong to the local machine (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Generation returns immediately; the official FAQ lists no async job queue or resume-after-shutdown surface, and embedded Office image features run in the host app’s foreground. Long-task state should be measured per entry (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: The product includes text-to-image, image editing such as background removal, design templates for social posts and posters, and image-to-video capabilities; the official FAQ describes Designer as a generative-AI graphic design tool. It overlaps template design tools such as Canva, but AI generation is the main axis (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Work is organised by project: projects persist in My projects in the cloud and link to OneDrive/Office, while the official FAQ lists no cross-session chat memory or user profile — project context lives in design files rather than a conversation thread (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: A Microsoft account is required. The official FAQ licenses Designer for personal, non-commercial use only; commercial use must be checked against the subscription tier and Microsoft terms. Training-use controls sit in the Microsoft privacy panel, while uploaded images live in OneDrive under account quota and deletion (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: lightweight design output for Microsoft-ecosystem users (social/post templates plus AI generation) and a free start. Not fit: model choice, open weights or leaving the Microsoft account (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the official FAQ and Microsoft terms for capability, storage and licensing boundaries. Generation quality, free/subscription quotas and commercial rights need account-level measurement.
unknowns:
- Exact current image-model version: not disclosed model by model in the official FAQ; check the product UI.
- Generation-quota difference between free and M365 tiers: the FAQ only says frequent use may need a subscription; check the account page.
- Tier boundary for commercial licensing: the FAQ states a personal non-commercial licence, so commercial use needs separate checking against Microsoft terms.
related: Same-ecosystem conversation entry: Designer is the design surface, Copilot the conversation surface.
Both big-vendor design AI lines: Firefly leans on the enterprise-compliance narrative, Designer on free lightweight.
